clauses.reason: The order exempts Whitney Gillilland, a member of the Civil Aeronautics Board, from mandatory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5 of the United States Code until June 30, 1975. The order recites that he became subject to mandatory retirement for age during January 1974 and had been exempted through December 31, 1974 by Executive Order No. 11756, an earlier order that is not a later event for this order. The held Federal Register text reads the end date as June 30,197 5 (an OCR spacing error); the date is June 30, 1975. The order is a single command with one fixed term, so its own stated date is the first end: 1975-06-30, recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is 1975-06-29. The order was signed 1974-12-28. No amendment, revocation or shortening of this order is held (searched below).

research_rationale:
EO 11824 (signed 1974-12-28) is a one-person exemption under section 8335(c) of title 5, United States Code: Whitney Gillilland, a member of the Civil Aeronautics Board, is exempted from mandatory retirement for age until June 30, 1975. The held Federal Register text of the order was read in full and is a single operative clause (the recital, the finding of public interest, and the exempting sentence). The order ends by its own terms on 1975-06-30 (inclusive; exclusive alternative 1975-06-29, owner ruling 2026-10-21 on until dates). Searches judged adequate: U.S. Code and eCFR (no hit naming the order), the Office of the Federal Register disposition-note catalog, and the held-text search for the person's full name, which found the chain members recorded above and nothing else. Whether the person left office on or before the stated date is not in any held source and is not asserted.

savings.reason: The exemption only suspended compulsory retirement for the stated term; it creates no continuing duty, office or rule. The person's service during the term and the pay for it had accrued by 1975-06-30; nothing in the order survives that date, and any later exemption is a separate grant recorded as a later event.
